comment: External tools of bench/pdf, downloaded by `node bench/pdf/setup.mjs` into bench/pdf/tools/<name>/ (gitignored). Every download is checked against `sha256` (pinned here) and, when the publisher publishes one, against the publisher's checksum fetched from `checksum.url` at setup time. Nothing is installed: archives are only extracted, and only the listed binaries are executed.

checksum.note: qpdf-12.4.2.sha256 is published next to the release assets (with a sigstore bundle)

jre.what: Java runtime for veraPDF only (portable zip, never installed; JAVA_HOME / PATH untouched)

verapdf.version: 1.28.2 (greenfield-apps, the shaded CLI jar published to Maven Central)
verapdf.what: veraPDF PDF/A-1b..4 and PDF/UA-1/-2 validation (run with the portable JRE: java -cp <jar> org.verapdf.apps.GreenfieldCliWrapper)

checksum.note: Maven Central publishes SHA-1 (and a PGP .asc) only; the SHA-256 is pinned here after the SHA-1 check

poppler.what: pdfinfo, pdffonts, pdftoppm (poppler Splash rasteriser), pdftotext

checksum.note: the SHA-256 digest GitHub publishes for the release asset

notTools.mupdf: mupdf-1.28.5-windows.zip (https://casper.mupdf.com/downloads/archive/mupdf-1.28.5-windows.zip, sha256 13476a53e84f5527983158acb6442c7853b3cdc022f3b24880780dcfba1fcc99, no publisher checksum) was tried: its mutool.exe does not start on this Windows 11 machine (STATUS_DLL_NOT_FOUND, 0xC0000135: api-ms-win-crt-utility-l1-1-0.dll), i.e. it needs the Visual C++ / UCRT redistributable installed system-wide, which this setup must not do. MuPDF is used through the official mupdf npm package (wasm, same engine: parse warnings + rasteriser) instead.
notTools.veraPDFInstaller: software.verapdf.org/releases/verapdf-installer.zip is an IzPack installer; not needed: the shaded greenfield-apps CLI jar is published on Maven Central and runs as is with the portable JRE.
notTools.pac: PAC (PDF Accessibility Checker) is a Windows GUI application without a CLI: not usable headless.
